Name: Shirtless(Optional) Improved Muscular Alex sprite replacement
Author: JepMZ
Description:
*edit* Portraits are now [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/399?]out![/url]

Inspired by keychain's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/349/?]Accurate Alex mod[/url] and using their mod with better front hair/darkerskin/accurate clothes as a base

In addition to Keychain's contribution, I went ahead and alter ConcernedApe's creation, Alex's workout routine. It was just two lines to suggest they're pecs originally. Gave his torso a more pleasing look along with altering keychain's Alex hair further. Became a scrapped project for a while until SV subreddit gave me some encouragement. I also strip off his shirt for walking, and gridballfiddling animation too fairly recently after someone told me Alex does not workout anymore after marriage and shall be an optional version to download.

If you have any urgent comments,feel free to comment in the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/4j76bt/anyone_want_a_more_defined_shirtless_alex_mod/]subreddit

[/url]Installation Guide:

1. Open zip file
2. Pick one of the two versions folder
3. Locate your Stardew Valley folder. usually it's in program file(86x)/Steam/Steamapp/common/stardey valley or something
4. Move the Content folder that's in your chosen version folder and drag it it into your Stardey Valley folder

*edit 5/23/2016

Added a bug report sheet. I'm way too colorblind to differentiate whatever shade this green I cant see and brown. I need help! If you're able, click on image tab and you'll find the bug report image. Open the image in your favorite paint program. Pick a stereotypical blue color (blues are complimentary colors of browns) and mark those pesky green pixels for me. That way i know which pixels to recolor. Thank you very much!

oh, and reupload it to here, or post a link to your bug report for me in the comments

*edit* 5/26/2016

New version is up, hopefully I set up the files correctly! Replaced the green pixels with brown (probably lol). Thank you my two editers for marking the exact pixels fo me!
